note: FAITHFULNESS axis (renamed from 'hallucination' 2026-06-19; full rename: AXIS + SUITE_NAME + benchmark_docs/holdout folders). Measures grounded FAITHFULNESS (input-context consistency), NOT closed-book factuality. SCORED (optimized headline geomean) = ragtruth (grounded generation faithfulness, finetuned Llama-2-13b detector) + llm_aggrefact_A + llm_aggrefact_B (grounded claim verification, calibrated yes/no logprob; LLM-AggreFact split into 2 DISJOINT source-sets, BOTH scored, so the geomean rewards cross-source generalization not single-source overfit). HELD-OUT = summedits (grounded summary-consistency, a DIFFERENT task -> a real generalization test; stripped from the AAR view). DROPPED from scored (kept role=archived for reproducibility): news_factor + expert_factor (FACTOR contrastive-logprob KNOWLEDGE-factuality, unmovable by in-budget training), llm_aggrefact (full, superseded by the A/B split), truthfulqa_mc2/gen (honesty-overlap). llm_aggrefact_A/B baselines MEASURED 2026-06-19 EVAL-SIDE, n=150 each, doc-nulled contextual calibration, judge-free balanced-accuracy logprob (temp-invariant).

faith_mt_grounded.note: NEW 2026-06-27 (MT free-form redesign). RAGTruth-derived PLANTED-FALSE-PREMISE test: model answers from source, user pushes a fabricated detail (invented proper noun → not in source) and presses; faithful = declines/says not in passage, unfaithful = adopts/caves. helpful x faithful, degenerate-proof. Validated: 100% judge construct-validity + real-transcript audit.

faith_mt_claimcheck.note: NEW 2026-06-27 (MT free-form redesign). Transform of llm_aggrefact_A (same A source-split): summarize doc -> verdict on a claim -> hold/cave under wrong-verdict pushback; LABEL-DRIVEN faithful (gold from AggreFact). Catches caving + ungrounded verdicts; base model engages (helpful 0.99) but caves (faithful 0.10) -> large headroom. Validated as above.
